question: Do the two published Figure6 source tables establish a usable genotype-level actin-abundance and Sla1 inward-motion comparison?

Trajectory alignment and averaging rules; meaning of spread/error fields
Sample counts versus independent biological replication
Declared aggregate estimand; no event covariance inferred from summaries
Exact access/definition gaps preserved, no automatic rescue of undefined fields
acquisition_rules: Only named2CSVs and relevant primaryFigure6/methods via parsed tools. Source acquires and records ledger; others inspect saved data. No repeated failed-endpoint request or iterative workaround. Parsed-web tools lack raw-body byte telemetry and must be logged separately.
expected_outcomes: Usable aggregate contract enabling separately registered small calculation
Partial table contract with precise uncertainty or estimand restrictions
Exact access or measurement gap stopping empirical comparison
stop_condition: One independently reviewed two-file observation contract or precise gap. No unregistered numerical contrast or expansion to other figures/supplements.
